✓ desktop settings disable forecast supply through the shared weather owner
✓ system, light and dark preferences propagate through both native windows and both settings hosts
✓ explicit compact-mode transition hides only desktop; status-item toggling preserves it and return retains selection/view/timer
✓ menu-only startup promotes once; close/reopen and compact dismissal retain desktop role, hierarchy and timer; selection reconciles
✓ search creation Cancel preserves query/data; Save clears search and reveals one durable new event on both surfaces
✓ nondefault native divider positions survive selection, mode, checklist, favorite, editor, settings and search-empty transitions

✓ synthetic pending/loaded, missing, global and per-event weather preserve overview/card/detail geometry in narrow/wide collection and feed

✓ completion can be toggled and reopened
✓ failed Save rolls back all stored fields; hide/show retains the draft and retry durably saves it

✓ diagnostics remain free of private editor input
